- Want: Orchard, Harbor
- Avoid: Library

- Blair adds Cedar
- Alex adds Maple

Additionally, rejecting would leave me with no new commitment; I would not get any point from Harbor. Accepting gives me a chance to score +1 on Harbor.

Thus, I should accept.
